summary.purpose: P1 playtest item: when a non-red player played 紅軍奧援 (acquired via the pass mechanic), play_card's special branch discarded it into the CASTER's own pile instead of returning the red-army-exclusive card to the red player's discard. Both action mode and resource mode now return it to the red player. 2026-08-08 update: red player's own RESOURCE-mode play no longer opens the anti-communist target-choice prompt (that only applies to action mode) — resource mode now grants resources immediately and discards to red's own pile, matching a normal resource card.
